svg.title: RPS Arena — Arcade, editable original sprite atlas
svg.desc: 12 rows: blue player 1 (own), then red player 2 (enemy); rock, paper, scissors, flag, trap, unknown. Flag cloth marks the opposing team target: red on blue tokens, blue on red tokens. Columns: idle 0/1, selected 0/1/2, move 0/1, duel 0/1, attack, win, lose. Bottom row: board light, board dark, logo. Native export: 1152 × 1248 pixels. All shapes are editable; no linked resources.
